value.rationale: The strong mathematical/physical motivation is metastability and kinetic trapping in competing-interaction Ising chains. Changing the field from zero to any small positive value changes absorbing-state entropy from zero to an explicit positive constant, with a sharp second annihilation threshold h=2K. The exact all-field classification and magnetization-resolved finite-volume counts allow tests and comparisons with actual kinetic sampling; these structural effects are not mere low-order computation or renamed textbook facts.
